## Cat4 RSC Test Runner — Reschedule + Notify

**Drives the Telegram VA through the reschedule_and_notify subcategory: pre-creates an event, has the VA move it and draft a heads-up email, then diffs the calendar + drafts to grade the run.**

### What it does
1. Reads the Cat4 multistep test-inputs tab (04_Multistep_Tasks_Tests).
2. Filters to the RSC subcategory only (see "Scope / filter" below), then loops one test at a time.
3. Pre-creates the original TEST_<id>: Team sync event (Mon 10:00–10:30, Europe/Sarajevo), waits 2s, then snapshots calendar + Gmail drafts BEFORE → calls the Telegram VA (Command Handler) → waits 30s → snapshots calendar + drafts AFTER → diff/grade.
4. Logs to the category4_results tab.
5. Cleanup: lists every TEST_<id> event and deletes them, then deletes the VA's notification draft (5s settle between tests).

### Scope / filter (keep this node)
Node "Keep RSC Pilot 5" (AND of two conditions):
- Subcategory equals reschedule_and_notify
- ID matches the RSC ID family

Despite the "Pilot 5" name, the ID condition matches ALL RSC IDs, so there is no pilot sub-sampling — it already runs the full RSC subcategory. The node is still load-bearing: 04_Multistep_Tasks_Tests is the SHARED tab holding all four Cat4 multistep subcategories (SDA/SRM/TRI/CAP as well), so removing this filter would pull those rows in. Keep it.

### Pass / grading
From Diff + Grade, per test it derives three signals:
- confirmation_requested (Y/N) — VA output contains [CONFIRMATION REQUESTED] (or equivalent confirm phrasing).
- event moved (Y/N) — the pre-created event's start changed (updated in place), or a new TEST_<id> event appeared (delete+recreate).
- draft created (Y/N) — a new Gmail draft exists vs. the BEFORE snapshot.

rescheduled_pass = Y only when all three are Y. status = success (moved event AND new draft), partial (one of them), else failed.

### Logs to
category4_results. Notable columns: test_id, subcategory, channel, calendar_event_id/title/description, calendar_event_start_iso/end_iso/day, draft_id, ai_output (first 800 chars), original_start_iso/end_iso, new_event_count, new_draft_count, response_time_ms, status, confirmation_requested, rescheduled_pass.

### Run plan
Trigger via Manual Trigger or webhook. Loop Over Tests runs one row at a time (default batchSize). All calendar ops use the shared assistant calendar; the invite goes to the owner.
